approved_slide.file: 72. Predictive Asset Maintenance Intelligence Agent one-pager.pptx

findings: New catalog template authored from an internal eight-step use-case outline for grid and asset operations; no prior library source covered transmission and distribution assets.
The outline relied on cloud IoT and machine-learning services for sensor streaming and health scoring; library solutions use only Copilot Studio, Microsoft 365, Power Platform and Dynamics 365.

The existing Predictive Maintenance Agent schedules manufacturing production lines and the Asset Maintenance Forecast Agent covers a wind-farm fleet; neither ranks grid assets, plans long-lead parts or checks the asset register.
Raising work orders, ordering parts, assigning crews and writing to the asset register are external actions and must not run from a synthetic template.
fixes: Authored a single-file, stdlib-only agent with 4 deterministic operations covering the eight steps over an invented utility snapshot behind one marked data-plane seam.

Mapped sensor aggregation and health scoring to a Dataverse condition-monitoring table filled by Power Automate, work orders to Dynamics 365 Field Service, field capture to Power Apps and fleet reporting to Power BI.

Represented every work order, parts order, crew assignment, register update and capital decision as a labeled draft or recommendation with an explicit no-action gate; dates are relative to the run date.
Used only a fictional utility, substations, assets, crews, people and identifiers.
Added one locked persona-language case and one uploadable skill per operation.
remaining_boundary: Production connections and all external actions require customer approval, least-privilege controls, and an authorized human workflow. Failure probabilities are decision support, not a safety determination.
